newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares follow Reliance higher.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares follow Reliance higher.

text.p: Reliance Industries led Delhi shares higher in early afternoon trade on Friday in what brokers called a technical correction.
At 12:45 p.m. (0715 GMT), the Delhi Stock Exchange's benchmark index was up 5.41 points at 773.91.
"The recovery in stock prices seems to be a technical correction as the market has bottomed out," said Sanjay Mittal of stockbrokers S.R.M. Securities.
Reliance Industries, boosted by rumours that it might make a bonus issue, gained 3.05 rupees to 298.80.
Larsen and Toubro, which on Thursday announced a rise in net profit to 4.1 billion rupees in 1996/97 (April-March) from 3.9 billion in the previous year, increased 4.50 rupees to 211.25.
TISCO rose 4.20 rupees to 173.20 as buyers emerged at lower price levels.
State Bank of India added 2.65 rupees to 308.50 on increased buying by both domestic and foreign investors.
Hindustan Lever was up 12 rupees to 1,095.
Smithkline Beecham Consumers Health rose 8.25 rupees to 352 on foreign buying.
